subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: Should this umbrella issue remain the human-owned tracker, or should maintainers split and route the TUI, sessions_send, WeChat, background-event flooding, and meaningful-activity subproblems into separate canonical items?
rationale: Current source supports several gaps, but one automated code path cannot safely cover core Gateway/TUI behavior, external WeChat plugin ownership, and activity/background-event semantics without a maintainer boundary decision.

options.title: Split and route subproblems
options.body: Create or reuse focused canonical items for each remaining behavior, preserving this report as the umbrella until all links are established.

options.title: Keep one umbrella tracker
options.body: Use this issue as the manual tracker and require live WeChat/background-event proof before any implementation work is queued.

options.title: Close only after linked fixes land
options.body: Wait for the narrower linked fixes or explicit decisions to cover every reported behavior before closing this issue.

recommendation.title: Split and route subproblems
recommendation.body: Create or reuse focused canonical items for each remaining behavior, preserving this report as the umbrella until all links are established.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest combined current-history signal across the TUI, session-list, sessions_send, and WeChat docs/product-boundary surfaces.
